SELECT * FROM ( SELECT scm10_dev_id AS dev_id , scm10_sr_id AS sr_id , scm10_person_id AS person_id , scm10_start_date AS start_date , scm10_due_date AS due_date , scm10_note AS note , scm10_reg_date AS reg_date , scm01_sr_status_cd AS sr_status_cd , regexp_replace(regexp_replace(scm10_note, '<[^>]*>', '', 'g'), E'&#[0-9]+;|&\w+;', '', 'g') AS arrange_note , emp01_kor_nm AS person_nm , scm01_sr_date AS sr_date , scm01_sr_no AS sr_no , f_cdnm('SystemCode', scm01_system_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS system_nm , scm01_requestor||CASE WHEN scm01_corp_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '('||f_get_corp_nm(scm01_corp_id)||')' END AS requestor , ( SELECT scm11_result_date FROM scm11_dev_step WHERE scm11_dev_id = scm10_dev_id AND scm11_result_cd LIKE '1' ORDER BY scm11_dev_step_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS result_date , f_get_dev_status(scm10_dev_id) AS dev_step_result , NULL::bigint AS dev_program_cnt -- DevRes 공용 열(이 목록 SQL에는 없다) , NULL::bigint AS file_cnt FROM scm10_dev INNER JOIN scm01_sr ON scm10_sr_id = scm01_sr_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = scm10_person_id WHERE f_trunc(scm10_reg_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND COALESCE(scm01_system_cd, '%') LIKE #{systemCode} ) t WHERE 1=1
AND COALESCE(sr_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('30', '80', '90') AND dev_step_result NOT IN ('완료', '이행불가')
AND #{personId} IN ( SELECT person_id UNION SELECT scm11_person_id FROM scm11_dev_step WHERE scm11_dev_id = dev_id AND scm11_dev_step_cd = '10' )
AND ( CONCAT(requestor, note, person_nm, dev_step_result, sr_no) ILIKE #{searchText} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scm11_dev_step WHERE scm11_dev_id = dev_id AND CONCAT(scm11_result, scm11_note) ILIKE #{searchText} ) )
AND dev_step_result LIKE #{devStatus} ORDER BY reg_date DESC, dev_id DESC
SELECT dev_status AS code , dev_status AS name FROM ( SELECT f_get_dev_status(scm10_dev_id) dev_status FROM scm10_dev ) t GROUP BY dev_status ORDER BY SUBSTR(dev_status, 1, 1), dev_status
